candidate.answerReason: Because B is positive and 5 units from -3, B represents 2. The midpoint coordinate is \((-3+2)/2=-1/2\).

methods.label: Average the endpoint coordinates
methods.explanation: B is to the right of the origin, so it represents \(-3+5=2\). The midpoint represents \((-3+2)\div2=-1/2\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 number-line coordinates, midpoint reasoning, and rational arithmetic.

methods.label: Move halfway along the segment
methods.explanation: Since \(A\) represents \(-3\) and \(B\) lies to the right of the origin, \(B\) is to the right of \(A\). The midpoint lies halfway along the segment, so it is \(5\div2=2.5\) units to the right of \(A\). Its coordinate is therefore \(-3+2.5=-0.5=-\frac12\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the midpoint definition and number-line movement directly, within Grade 7 prerequisites.
